title: Rent Roll
description: Rent Roll contract normalized from the DocuBricks Real estate library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-real-estate-rent-roll
  title: Rent Roll
  description: Rent Roll contract normalized from the DocuBricks Real estate library.
  version: real_estate_rent_roll_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: real_estate/rent_roll
    sourcePath: Schemas/real_estate/rent_roll
    sourceVersion: real_estate_rent_roll_v1
    sourceDigest: 904fbc2d7fd7900809776c0ad75f2120ced29b309a11d230e7c0b61a9c524cdd
spec:
  documentType: rent_roll
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - rent-roll-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - occupied-units-or-suites
        - report-preparer
        - vacant-units
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - delinquent-amount
        - monthly-scheduled-rent
        - occupancy-rate
        - total-units-or-suites
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - owner-name
        - property-name
        - tenant-entries
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - property-address
  fields:
    - id: rent-roll-date
      name: rent_roll_date
      label: Rent Roll Date
      description: Date of rent roll.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/rent_roll_date
    - id: property-name
      name: property_name
      label: Property Name
      description: Property name.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/property_name
    - id: property-address
      name: property_address
      label: Property Address
      description: Property address.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/property_address
    - id: owner-name
      name: owner_name
      label: Owner Name
      description: Owner name.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/owner_name
    - id: total-units-or-suites
      name: total_units_or_suites
      label: Total Units Or Suites
      description: Total units or suites.
      dataType: integer
      sourcePath: /fields/total_units_or_suites
    - id: occupied-units-or-suites
      name: occupied_units_or_suites
      label: Occupied Units Or Suites
      description: Occupied units or suites.
      dataType: integer
      sourcePath: /fields/occupied_units_or_suites
    - id: occupancy-rate
      name: occupancy_rate
      label: Occupancy Rate
      description: Occupancy rate percentage.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/occupancy_rate
    - id: tenant-entries
      name: tenant_entries
      label: Tenant Entries
      description: Tenant rows with unit, tenant, lease dates, area, rent, and arrears.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/tenant_entries
    - id: monthly-scheduled-rent
      name: monthly_scheduled_rent
      label: Monthly Scheduled Rent
      description: Total monthly scheduled rent.
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/monthly_scheduled_rent
    - id: delinquent-amount
      name: delinquent_amount
      label: Delinquent Amount
      description: Total delinquent or past due amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/delinquent_amount
    - id: vacant-units
      name: vacant_units
      label: Vacant Units
      description: Vacant units or suites.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/vacant_units
    - id: report-preparer
      name: report_preparer
      label: Report Preparer
      description: Preparer or property manager.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/report_preparer
  validationRules:
    - id: rent-roll-date-present
      severity: error
      description: rent_roll_date is required for Rent Roll extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: rent_roll_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: rent_roll_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: rent_roll_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(rent_roll_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: property-address-present
      severity: error
      description: property_address is required for Rent Roll extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: property_address
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: property_address
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: property_address IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(property_address)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: tenant-entries-present
      severity: error
      description: tenant_entries is required for Rent Roll extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: tenant_entries
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: tenant_entries
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: tenant_entries IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(tenant_entries) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: monthly-scheduled-rent-present
      severity: error
      description: monthly_scheduled_rent is required for Rent Roll extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: monthly_scheduled_rent
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: monthly_scheduled_rent
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: monthly_scheduled_rent IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(monthly_scheduled_rent)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-units-or-suites-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: total_units_or_suites should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: total_units_or_suites
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: total_units_or_suites
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_units_or_suites IS NULL OR total_units_or_suites >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: occupied-units-or-suites-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: occupied_units_or_suites should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: occupied_units_or_suites
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: occupied_units_or_suites
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: occupied_units_or_suites IS NULL OR occupied_units_or_suites >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: occupancy-rate-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: occupancy_rate should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: occupancy_rate
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: occupancy_rate
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: occupancy_rate IS NULL OR occupancy_rate >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: monthly-scheduled-rent-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: monthly_scheduled_rent should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: monthly_scheduled_rent
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: monthly_scheduled_rent
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: monthly_scheduled_rent IS NULL OR monthly_scheduled_rent >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: delinquent-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: delinquent_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: delinquent_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: delinquent_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: delinquent_amount IS NULL OR delinquent_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      rent_roll_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Rent Roll workflow.
      property_address:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Rent Roll workflow.
      tenant_entries:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Rent Roll workflow.
      monthly_scheduled_rent:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Rent Roll workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Rent Roll documents combine real estate parties, property, title, lease, financial, and operating
      context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      rent_roll_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of rent roll.
        format: date
      property_name:
        type: string
        description: Property name.
      property_address:
        type: string
        description: Property address.
      owner_name:
        type: string
        description: Owner name.
      total_units_or_suites:
        type: integer
        description: Total units or suites.
      occupied_units_or_suites:
        type: integer
        description: Occupied units or suites.
      occupancy_rate:
        type: number
        description: Occupancy rate percentage.
      tenant_entries:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            unit_or_suite:
              type: string
              description: Unit, suite, space, or apartment identifier.
            tenant_name:
              type: string
              description: Tenant name.
            lease_start_date:
              type: date
              description: Lease start date.
              format: date
            lease_end_date:
              type: date
              description: Lease end date.
              format: date
            area_sq_ft:
              type: number
              description: Leased area in square feet.
            monthly_rent_amount:
              type: number
              description: Monthly rent amount.
            arrears_amount:
              type: number
              description: Past-due or delinquent amount.
            security_deposit_amount:
              type: number
              description: Security deposit amount if stated.
        description: Tenant rows with unit, tenant, lease dates, area, rent, and arrears.
      monthly_scheduled_rent:
        type: number
        description: Total monthly scheduled rent.
      delinquent_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total delinquent or past due amount.
      vacant_units:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Vacant units or suites.
      report_preparer:
        type: string
        description: Preparer or property manager.
    required:
      - rent_roll_date
      - property_address
      - tenant_entries
      - monthly_scheduled_rent
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: property_management
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - rent_roll_date
          - property_address
          - tenant_entries
          - monthly_scheduled_rent
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - tenant_entries
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
